items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1969-12-14
items.q: Moose is a wonderful cornet player.

ctx.x: Well, look, I wonder if you could tell me where I could get this book, Bugles for Bidebeck. It's a London publication. I don't know of anybody that handles it yet. Could you tell me?

Well, I could get the name and address of a place in London. I probably could order it out of Doug Doble's record shop there. I think that's 77 Charing Cross Road, London, England. But I could give you an exact address if you'll call me tomorrow at Tulane. Call you at Tulane? Yes. I sure will. Hi, Moose. Hi. Moose is a wonderful cornet player. Yeah. Do you take requests, Moose? Play Make Me a Pallet on the floor next time we get up there. Okay. Okay. Play the saints, will you? Okay. Okay. Thank you for calling,…
Now, once again, here is your moderator, Joe Collado.
